ablations: Detector-variant ablations, DESCRIPTIVE, not gated. On grid_world first 2 seeds: D0/D1/D2 learned (D3 frozen totals reused). On delayed_reward first 2 seeds: D1/D2/D3 learned (D0 frozen totals reused -- D0 is the 0080 rule verbatim). The load-bearing surface is the detector classification; everything else is the same inherited code.
background: EXP-FP-0120 proved ECR's hardcoded r>=1.0 terminal detector silently misfires on grid_world: the goal tick pays -0.02+1.00=0.98 < 1.0, so terminal success is absorbed as a shaping tick and the episodic lock-in (branch + progress cap-set) never executes (learned ~ frozen, 0/4). The 012x bound statement lists 'a learned/adaptive success threshold (not the hardcoded 1.0)' as harvest integration constraint (a). This experiment IS that experiment.
baseline: frozen = identical adaptive-detector class, frozen=True, gains pinned 1.0, paired per seed (detector stats frozen too -- frozen is variant-independent).
conditions: grid_world v1.0.0 (8 eps x <=100 steps, branch_channels = all movement channels, GoalCountingAdapter); delayed_reward v1.0.0 (8 eps x <=15 steps, branch_channels={branch_a,branch_b}, CanonicalAdapter). arch_a WorkspaceTick, neutral specialists, capacity=4, gain_lr=0.15, theta=0.45, gain_cap=2.0. ECR module attention_ecr_repro.py UNTOUCHED; new additive subclass only. Fresh seeds: grid_world {88101,88102,88103,88104}; delayed_reward {88201,88202,88203,88204} (word-boundary grep: zero prior use in the flesh-pits tree at sealing time).

detector_design.D0_hardcoded: r >= 1.0 (current ECR; the 0120 failure mode; expected to reproduce 0/4 on grid_world)
detector_design.D1_floor: r >= FLOOR, FLOOR=0.1 (tests whether the floor alone, no relativity, suffices)
detector_design.D2_baseline: r > max(K*B_pos, FLOOR), K=2.0, B_pos = EMA(alpha=0.1) of r>0 ticks (the parent's 'k x running baseline' phrasing, positive-only)
detector_design.D3_relmax_main: r >= max(FLOOR, REL*r_big), REL=0.5, r_big = running max of r>0 ticks (the H1 detector)
detector_design.parameters_frozen: FLOOR=0.1, REL=0.5, K=2.0, alpha=0.1 -- no tuning; chosen from first principles (scale floor one order of magnitude below terminal, above per-tick shaping/penalties <= 0.05).
detector_design.site: the single classification point in update_gains where the parent writes `if reward >= _SUCCESS_REWARD:`; all other paths (shaping 0<r, pre-branch no-op, r==0, truncation, clamping, gain_history) are inherited behaviorally identical. The agent stays state-blind (reward stream only).
detector_design.stats_update: r_big / B_pos updated on every r>0 tick AFTER classification (novel relative to history); terminal ticks update the stats too.

frozen_gates.G0: canonical files byte-identical pre/post: attention_ecr_repro.py, attention.py, tick.py, grid_world.py, delayed_reward.py, k5_multitask_generalization.py
frozen_gates.G1: fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on all new code, pre-run
frozen_gates.G2: determinism spot-check per env: first-seed D3 learned arm recomputed, total match at 1e-12, else VOID
frozen_gates.G3: hash-chained receipt via experiments/harness.py write_receipt + verify_chain

honest_prior: D3 will fire the lock-in on grid_world, but the progress-channel ID falls back to the canonical-first movement channel there (no shaping stream -- the same tie-break degeneracy as changing_rule in EXP-FP-0122). Whether first-branch lock-in alone beats frozen's goal luck is genuinely uncertain -- EXP-FP-0120 showed frozen reaching goals 2/14 episodes by luck. D1/D2 are expected to behave ~identically to D3 on both envs (no tick falls in (0.1, 1.0) except goal-class ticks); D2's EMA differentiates only on heterogeneous positive streams, absent here -- so the ablation is expected to show the floor doing the work, with relativity as insurance, not magic.
hypothesis: H1: replacing ECR's hardcoded terminal detector (r >= 1.0) with a scale-relative detector -- terminal iff r > 0 AND r >= max(FLOOR=0.1, REL=0.5 * r_big), where r_big = running max of positive per-tick rewards -- restores the episodic lock-in on grid_world (goal tick 0.98 >= 0.1 fires, where 0.98 < 1.0 never fired) AND preserves the home-env behavior on canonical delayed_reward (shaping 0.02 < 0.1 stays shaping; terminal 1.0 fires).
limitations: 4 seeds/env; neutral specialists (bandit isolation); branch_channels priors given; the floor 0.1 is itself a scale prior, not learned -- a fully learned threshold is a further experiment, not this one.
null: H0: the adaptive detector does not produce a seed-consistent learned>frozen goal-episode advantage on grid_world on 4/4 seeds, OR it regresses the home env (R < 1.30 on >= 1 delayed_reward seed).
preregistered_metric: grid_world: goal_episodes(learned_D3) vs goal_episodes(frozen_D3) per seed; WIN iff learned > frozen (strict). delayed_reward: R = total(learned_D3)/total(frozen_D3) per seed; WIN iff R >= 1.30. GATE: grid_world 4/4 AND delayed_reward 4/4 both fire -> H1 SUPPORTED. R-gate invalid on grid_world (negative per-tick rewards invert the ratio) -- preregistered adaptation from EXP-FP-0120.
title: Adaptive terminal detector for ECR (EXP-FP-0120 misfire follow-up)

verdict_mapping.grid_4_4_and_dr_4_4: H1 SUPPORTED -- the adaptive detector is INTEGRATED (pending replication breadth; CAUSAL label withheld as in EXP-FP-0007 precedent)
verdict_mapping.grid_fails_or_dr_regresses: H0 -- the detector is a clean kill; record the mechanism of the failure; the 0120 bound (ECR requires an undiluted terminal signal) stands unmodified

why_this_hypothesis: Of the three candidate directions, this has the highest expected information gain: (1) EXP-FP-0120 is the cleanest single-line mechanism break in Phase 8 -- one comparison misfires, diagnosed precisely with receipts; (2) the fix is small, falsifiable, and the gate is two-sided (must FIX grid_world AND must NOT regress the home env), so a win is a genuine generalization and a loss is a clean kill; (3) the self/world probe (option 2) already landed as EXP-SW-01/EXP-SW-02-B/EXP-FP-0060-ATTRIBUTION and the retrieval-usefulness gate (option 3) landed as EXP-FP-0040 NO-DEFICIT -- re-running landed work has low marginal gain; (4) per-unit-compute, this is the cheapest experiment in the menu (two small envs, 14 probes/env) with the most load-bearing surface (the detector classification).
